broadcasts.title: Heavy Rain Alert – Nanded District
broadcasts.message: IMD has issued a heavy rain warning for Nanded district from Oct 18-20. Farmers are advised to harvest ready crops and cover stored produce.

broadcasts.title: PM-KISAN 18th Installment – Apply Now
broadcasts.message: The 18th installment of PM-KISAN has been released. Farmers who have not updated their eKYC must do so before Oct 31 to receive ₹2000.
